overview: The paper proposes Difference Predictive Coding (DiffPC), a spike-native predictive coding framework for Spiking Neural Networks that replaces dense floating-point communication with sparse ternary spikes and adaptive threshold scheduling to achieve high communication efficiency and competitive accuracy on image classification tasks.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Augmentation
modules.description: Handles loading, normalization, and format conversion for MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 datasets, applying specific data augmentation strategies like random translation jitter and random horizontal flips as required by the experimental setups.

modules.name: Spiking Neuron Model
modules.description: Implements the Integrate-and-Fire neuron dynamics with ternary spike activation, including the membrane potential update rule and the spiking ReLU masking operation to ensure non-negative actual activity states.

modules.name: Adaptive Threshold Scheduler
modules.description: Implements the cyclic, cyclic decay, and constant decay scheduling mechanisms for the adaptive firing threshold and inference learning rate, controlling the step size of state updates across timesteps.

modules.name: DiffPC Network Layer
modules.description: Constructs the fundamental building block of the DiffPC architecture, managing local layer states including target activity, actual activity, forward prediction, and error variables (target, actual, and backward accumulated errors), along with the spike generation logic for both activity and error signals.

modules.name: Network Architecture Assembly
modules.description: Assembles DiffPC layers into fully connected Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures, managing the feedforward prediction pathways and feedback error propagation connections between adjacent layers.

modules.name: Feed-Forward Initialization
modules.description: Executes the single-pass forward propagation phase before iterative settling to prime the forward predictions and target activities, reducing the number of subsequent iterative steps required for convergence.

modules.name: DiffPC Iterative Settling Engine
modules.description: Implements the core timestep loop of the DiffPC algorithm, orchestrating the bidirectional flow of information where target activities are updated based on prediction errors, spikes are generated based on state discrepancies, and actual states are adjusted incrementally.

modules.name: Local Synaptic Plasticity Optimizer
modules.description: Implements the local weight update rule derived from free-energy minimization, where synaptic weights are updated based solely on local post-synaptic error states and pre-synaptic activity states, integrated with the AdamW optimization strategy.

modules.name: Training Pipeline Manager
modules.description: Orchestrates the end-to-end training workflow, managing epochs, iterating over data batches, clamping input/output layers during training, and sequentially executing the feed-forward initialization, iterative settling, and weight update phases.

modules.name: Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Handles model evaluation during testing, clamping only the input layer, running the feed-forward initialization and iterative settling process, and decoding the final output layer state to generate classification predictions.

modules.name: Communication Efficiency Metrics
modules.description: Calculates and tracks communication efficiency indicators, including the average number of bits transmitted per neuron during error propagation, the average number of spikes per neuron, and the total timesteps required for convergence.

modules.name: Event-Driven Response Analyzer
modules.description: Implements the experimental procedure to validate the event-driven nature of the network by tracking spiking activity over time in response to static inputs and measuring the spike burst triggered by abrupt input changes.

modules.name: Hyperparameter Sensitivity and Ablation Framework
modules.description: Provides an execution framework to systematically vary scheduler hyperparameters like cycle length and decay factor to evaluate their impact on the trade-off between classification accuracy, communication cost, and runtime.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Tracking
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations, handles the logging of training metrics, communication efficiency statistics, and validation accuracies, and provides utilities for model checkpoint persistence.
